outcome.answer: Lucie Flek is a matching author, and the closest paper is [1]. [1] presents MiniFool, a physics-inspired adversarial attack algorithm for particle and astroparticle physics that combines a chi-squared-based test statistic with deviation from a target score. [1] A related later paper by the same author also studies subtle perturbations consistent with experimental uncertainties to fool neural networks in high-energy physics, but it is about hidden systematics rather than a new attack algorithm [8].
